basics.name: Vaibhav Jain
basics.about: Product Engineer and IT Consultant experienced in startup and freelance ecosystems. I develop software and produce solutions, and apply machine learning concepts to projects for smarter outcomes.

responsibilities: Build micro-applications based on client requirements using JavaScript, React, MongoDB, and AWS.
Translate client needs into practical, reliable software solutions.
Engineered content-driven websites using Astro and Nuxt with Island Architecture, achieving 40% faster page load times and improved Core Web Vitals scores.
Executed Payload CMS integration with Node.js, cutting client content update time by 60% while maintaining full Vue/Nuxt frontend performance.
Assisted the team with setting up machine learning pipelines.
Guided and mentored interns on working effectively with ML models.
Handled technical communication, project planning, and client presentations.
Maintained and optimized the company website, decreasing page load time by 30% and ensuring 99% uptime.
Analyzed user behavior and delivered UX recommendations that improved site engagement by 20% across key conversion funnels.
Architected and deployed a full-stack e-commerce platform, achieving a 25% increase in custom orders and reducing operational overhead by 75%.
Streamlined secure order and payment processing gateways, reducing checkout processing time by 20%.

projects.name: VA-task-executor
projects.description: Desktop voice assistant that listens and executes commands (open app/file/folder/url, read files, etc.).

projects.name: Vehicle Traffic Monitoring and Analysis
projects.description: Built a web dashboard using React-Leaflet, React-STT, Web Speech API, Gemini LLM, Facebook-BART, and Firebase. A multi-layered AI agent reduced operator workload by 90% by accepting simple human queries and routing operations automatically.

projects.name: OneBox
projects.description: An email management system with real-time IMAP sync, RAG-based reply suggestions, and enterprise-grade search. Includes Slack push notifications, webhook integration, and bulk indexing maintained by Docker Elasticsearch.

projects.name: CLIBrowser
projects.description: Browser extension with a terminal-style interface.

projects.name: Agent-task-manager
projects.description: Developed and deployed a secure MERN stack (MongoDB, Express, React, Node.js) application featuring JWT authentication and automated CSV/Excel task processing via Multer. The system maintained 100% data integrity upon file upload.

projects.name: Drag_drop_swipe
projects.description: Developed an open-source Node.js module enabling dependency-free drag, drop, and swipe interactions, compatible with both Node.js and vanilla HTML projects.

projects.name: University Time-table generator
projects.description: Automated the scheduling process for a university time-table generator, solving over 100 constraints across departments and labs. This reduced manual effort by 90% and saved over 100 hours of administrative work per semester using Backtracking, Genetic Algorithms, and OR-Tools.

projects.name: HOSPITAL-MANAGEMENT-SYSTEM
projects.description: Built a comprehensive no-code hospital management system using Bubble.io, which streamlined patient registration, appointment scheduling, and record management, reducing administrative time by an estimated 30%.
